description: Deliberately simplified first-order smoothing of gain reduction in the dB domain. Not a FabFilter emulation or audio measurement. τ values are model constants, not calibrated plugin knob values.

attack.assumptions: Constant target after t=0; no lookahead, hold, knee or detector smoothing modelled.

release.assumptions: Target steps to zero and stays there, no retrigger or hold; 180 ms is the assumed recovery window after release starts, not necessarily onset-to-onset spacing.

tempo.limitation: Onset intervals are timing references, not release settings; articulation and sustained signal shorten actual recovery window.

static_ratio.assumptions: Steady state hard-knee downward compression with no makeup gain; not transient response.
